author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Tiny Eden, a cozy first-person farming simulation game developed by Bajka Games. Players will ensure flowers bloom and thrive amongst a futuristic city. Design a rooftop garden, make new plant types, and cultivate a lively space. Tiny Eden is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Tiny Eden - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Playtest Gameplay Trailer for Ultrablight, a bullet heaven action roguelike game developed by Iron Balls. Players will take on waves of demons through multiple circles of Hell. Set up powerful builds, take on bosses, and master the game's fluid movement. Ultrablight is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a playtest launching on September 14 on Steam.
title: Ultrablight - Official Playtest Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX announcement trailer for this upcoming RPG card game. Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Tag Force 3 is reborn as Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX, featuring modern visuals, enhanced Dueling, and cards from the Yu-Gi-Oh! GX anime era. Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and Steam on February 16, 2027.
title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX - Official Announcement Trailer | Nintendo Direct September 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the latest teaser for Samurai Pizza Cats: Blast From The Past!, an upcoming 2D action-adventure game. The new teaser unveils that Samurai Pizza Cats: Blast From The Past! will have a demo at this year's Tokyo Game Show (TGS 2026). The Samurai Pizza Cats are back! Take control of the Pizza Cats and prevent The Big Cheese from taking over Little Tokyo once and for all in Samurai Pizza Cats: Blast From The Past!
title: Samurai Pizza Cats: Blast From The Past! - Official Demo Teaser Trailer | TGS 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the extended story trailer for Hela: of Mice & Magic, an upcoming 3D open-world action-adventure game set in a world inspired by Northern Sweden. When the Kind Witch can no longer care for the forest alone, she shares a little of her magic with the smallest of companions. See how her mouse familiars—and their magical Froggy Backpacks—came to be. Hela: of Mice & Magic will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2 on December 1, 2026.
title: Hela: of Mice & Magic - Official Story and Release Date Trailer | Nintendo Direct September 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for Danganronpa 2x2, an anime detective mystery visual novel developed by Gemdrops. Players will survive a deadly game by Monokuma on Jabberwock Island to determine who's responsible for a sinister situation. Danganronpa 2x2 is launching on January 14, 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Danganronpa 2x2 - Official Release Date Trailer | Nintendo Direct September 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Nintendo Switch 2 Announcement Trailer for Palia, the hit free-to-play life simulation adventure RPG developed by Singularity 6 Corporation. Players can enjoy the world of Palia on the go with Nintendo Switch 2, packed with enhanced performance, richer visuals, Joy-Con 2 mouse control, and more. The upcoming Echo Expeditions is also coming to Palia in Holiday 2026 for Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Palia - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Announcement Trailer | Nintendo Direct September 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the '1v1 Annihilation Orks vs Necrons' Gameplay Overview for Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4, an upcoming real-time strategy action game developed by King Art. Players can witness an intense face-off against Creative Director Jan Theysen and QA Lead Orvie Thumel in an Annihilation Battle, with Orks and Necrons taking to the battlefield. Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 is launching on December 3 for PC (Steam).
title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 - Official '1v1 Annihilation Orks vs Necrons' Gameplay Overview

author: GameTrailers
description: Truckful gets a new trailer showcasing gameplay, more of the story, and a release date. Check out the Truckful release date trailer for this upcoming action-adventure mystery game. Navigate tricky roads, solve village mysteries, and stay away from the forest! Truckful will be available on Steam on October 9, 2026.
title: Truckful - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Gameplay Trailer for Bluey's Happy Snaps, a 2D adventure game developed by Gameloft. Players can explore iconic locations from the world of Bluey with Dad's old camera in hand. Capture photos in beloved settings from the hit show and embark on a grand adventure in Bluey's Happy Snaps, launching on October 15 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Xbox on PC, Epic Games Store, and Steam).
title: Bluey's Happy Snaps - Official Gameplay Trailer | Nintendo Direct September 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Nintendo Switch 2 Reveal Trailer for Onyx: The Dark Grip, a 2D dark adventure game developed by Broken Mirror Games and Bloober Team. Players will survive a brutal world by assuming control of an ordinary human as a godlike being beyond the bounds of the game world. Reshape reality itself in Onyx: The Dark Grip, launching on Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027.
title: Onyx: The Dark Grip - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Reveal Trailer | Nintendo Direct September 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
That cure of life, shall whisper of poison. Check out The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother announcement trailer for the upcoming console game adaptation of The Apothecary Diaries, featuring a new story conceptualized by series author Hyuganatsu. 

In The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother, two chains of strange phenomenon and conspiracies are causing chaos throughout the rear palace, red-light district, and streets of the capital. Apothecary Maomao must use every ounce of her intelligence and knowledge to solve the mysteries and unveil the truth behind the False Imperial Brother before it destroys the imperial court.
title: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother - Official Reveal Trailer | Nintendo Direct 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Mutant Football League 2: Antarctica Scumdogs announcement trailer, as the metal band GWAR is coming to the sports game in this DLC pack. Mutant Football League 2: Antarctica Scumdogs will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Steam, and Xbox Series X/S in October 2026.

In the Mutant Football League 2: Antarctica Scumdogs, GWAR tore a new cosmic wormhole in the fabric of space and spilled out into the Mutant Football League 2 universe, where sport is almost as violent as they are — where players are mutilated, referees can be murdered, cheating is encouraged, and sometimes the best defense is simply killing the other team.

The GWAR Mutant Football League 2 team includes Blöthar the Berserker, BälSäc the Jaws 'O Death, JiZMak Da Gusha, Grodius Maximus, Beefcake the Mighty, Sawborg Destructo, and Bonesnapper. The DLC also features a new stadium and more.
title: Mutant Football League 2: Antarctica Scumdogs x GWAR - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Romancing SaGa 3 announcement trailer for the upcoming remake of the turn-based RPG adventure game. The Romancing SaGa 3 features fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. In Romancing SaGa 3, choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny. Romancing SaGa 3 will be available on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC on February 16, 2027.
title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United - Official Announce Trailer | Nintendo Direct September 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves × Tokyo Revengers teaser trailer as Manjiro "Mikey" Sano and Ken "Draken" Ryuguji from Tokyo Revengers join the fighting game as Season Pass 3 DLC characters. Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves is available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, Steam, and Epic Games Store. It is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on October 22, 2026. The Tokyo Revengers characters arrive in Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves on October 22, 2026.
title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves × Tokyo Revengers - Official Sano & Ryuguji Teaser | Nintendo Direct

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Release Date Trailer for Gennady, a stylized roguelike platformer developed by Feed 64. Players will traverse ever-shifting corridors to take on all manner of creatures and grow stronger in the process. Dash, overcome obstacles, and survive in Gennady, launching on October 28 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and GoG).
title: Gennady - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a deep dive into the Gunlance Boosted Action in this latest Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance trailer for the upcoming action RPG expansion. The new trailer spotlights the Gunlance and breaks down its Boosted Action. Fearlessly charge in with the Boost Driver. The Gunlance Boosted Action features more explosions, and you can defend and reload.

Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance takes the hunt to new heights in Master Rank. New monsters and challenges, evolved hunting actions and mechanics, a new locale, and the next chapter in the Expedition Team's story await in Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.
title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance - Official Gunlance Boosted Action Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Season 10 Battle Pass Trailer for Marvel Rivals, the hit free-to-play team-based action shooter developed by NetEase Games. Players can get an extensive look at the new cosmetics coming to the Season 10 Battle Pass, with new skins for Loki, Squirrel Girl, Hawkeye, Punisher, and more. Season 10 for Marvel Rivals is launching on September 11 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Marvel Rivals - Official Season 10 Battle Pass Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Ondeh Ondeh Kaya’s Tasty Tale announcement trailer for this upcoming rhythm and puzzle action-adventure game developed by Metronomik. Embark on a magical journey inspired by the vibrant cultures of Southeast Asia. Ondeh Ondeh Kaya’s Tasty Tale will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam in 2027.

In Ondeh Ondeh Kaya's Tasty Tale, take on the role of Kaya and set off on a heartwarming, coming-of-age journey centred on family, courage, and self-discovery to become a Worldbuilder, just like her parents. To be certified, one must first pass a test: gather all the Giants across the world and perform the Renewal Ritual to rejuvenate the flavours of the world.
title: Ondeh Ondeh Kaya’s Tasty Tale - Official Announcement Trailer | Nintendo Direct September 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Nintendo Switch 2 Pre-Order Trailer for Stellar Blade, the hit third-person action RPG developed by Shift Up. Players will take on an unforgiving post-apocalyptic world as Eve to slay enemies and save what remains of the world. Access NieR: Automata and NIKKE: GODDESS OF VICTORY DLCs alongside the all-new costume collaboration with Bayonetta for Stellar Blade, launching on November 5 for Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Stellar Blade - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Pre-Order Trailer | Nintendo Direct September 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Become a magical Merfolk and explore the underwater worlds. Watch the latest Disney Dreamlight Valley trailer to see what to expect with The Keepsake Sea expansion for the sim life game. The Keepsake Sea expansion brings Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, and Megara to the game. The expansion also features a new storyline, unique biomes, and new underwater areas to uncover and customize. Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea expansion will be available in November 2026.

In Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea, become friends with Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, and Megara as you embark on an adventure to reach a faraway kingdom across the sea and discover strange echoes of its past.
title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea - Official Announce Trailer | Nintendo Direct 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer for Crisis Core: Final Fantasy 7 Reunion, the remaster of the acclaimed action RPG developed by Square Enix. Players can play through the legendary events seven years before the original Final Fantasy 7 as Zack searches for the mission Soldier Genesis. Protect your honor as Soldier in Crisis Core: Final Fantasy 7 Reunion, available now for Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Crisis Core: Final Fantasy 7 Reunion - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer | Nintendo Direct

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date Trailer for Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition, the hit action-adventure RPG developed by Eidos Montreal. Players can get the band back together as the Guardians of the Galaxy face off against the Universal Church of Truth, with new glam rock outfits to sport. Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition is launching on November 5 for Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date Trailer

description: Xiri: Oasis Cities is a survival-driven city-builder set in a high-tech future. It's in development for PC. You can wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5135950/XIRI_Oasis_Cities
title: Xiri: Oasis Cities – Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Hookeye, a psychological fishing horror game developed by Mallorian and FloralNoise. Players will embody an obsessed fisher with nothing but his fishing lines, some beer, and time to burn on the water. Trade whatever's necessary for the next big catch in Hookeye, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Hookeye - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Mayhem à la Carte announcement trailer for this upcoming four-player co-op cooking game-meets-first-person-shooter. In Mayhem à la Carte, players must work together to prepare and serve increasingly complicated meals while defending their kitchen from waves of attackers determined to ruin dinner service. Mayhem à la Carte will be available on PC in Steam Early Access in 2027.
title: Mayhem a la Carte - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Drift Attack Release Date Trailer for Forza Horizon 6, the latest in the racing simulation franchise developed by Playground Games. Players can soon access the Drift Attack mode, tasking drivers with racking up the best drift score and ascending the leaderboards to claim the top spot. Drift Attack mode in Forza Horizon 6 is launching on September 10 for Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Steam).
title: Forza Horizon 6 - Official Drift Attack Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Your average, ordinary student residing in Tokyo. Meet Minato and see this character in action in the latest Dead or Alive 6: Last Round trailer for the fighting game. Tokyo JK, Minato (voiced by Shion Wakayama) joins Dead or Alive 6: Last Round on September 10, 2026. Dead or Alive 6: Last Round is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam.

Learn more about Minato from the trailer's official description: Minato is remarkably athletic and agile, which helped her take her dance skills to victory in a major international competition. Though winning was "nice", she's always cared more about how dance can bring people together.

Her new part-time gig is helping her scientist friend NiCO with odd jobs. One of those tasks involves equipping a special device that "can recreate 'R'" and facing off against other participants during the DOA Tournament. The device's workings, and her true objective, remain unknown...
title: Dead or Alive 6: Last Round - Official Minato Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Mega Man Reveal Trailer for Fortnite, the hit third-person battle royale game developed by Epic Games. Players can drop from the Battle Bus as Mega Man himself, equipped with his signature Mega Busters, Rush at his side, and more ties to the larger Mega Man universe with Zero in the mix. Fight as Mega Man on September 10 in Fortnite.
title: Fortnite - Official Mega Man Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: The solo-developed single-player tactical military first-person shooter Black One Blood Brothers is getting a major new update that adds a tactical phone, a new map, new equipment, new weapons, and new gear. That update is available now. Black One Blood Brothers is due to launch its full 1.0 release in 2027, but is currently available in Steam Early Access if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1621560/Black_One_Blood_Brothers/
title: Black One Blood Brothers - Official Major Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this deep dive trailer for the Cosmos update for Hello Games space-exploration fan-favorite: No Man's Sky. The massive update promises deeper space exploration, space-station ownership, orbital bases, as well as expansions to Star Maps and more events to make space feel alive! 

Cosmos launches in No Man's Sky on September 9th free for all players on PC (Steam), PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 1, Nintendo Switch 2, Mac, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S.
title: No Man's Sky - Official Cosmos Deep Dive Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this first look at the Cosmos update for No Man's Sky. Cosmos promises to expand the space exploration, filling out the vast void of space with new events like Hulks, giant ships that can be stripped for resources. You'll also be able to own your own space-station and create an orbital base anywhere you wish. 

Cosmos launches in No Man's Sky on September 9th free for all players on PC (Steam), PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 1, Nintendo Switch 2, Mac, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S.
title: No Man's Sky - Official Cosmos Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the launch trailer for Valheim 1.0 for another look at this Viking survival game. The version 1.0 update will bring the arrival of Deep North, Valheim’s final biome, wrought with ancient evils and lurking threats. What at first seems like a picturesque postcard is bound to quickly turn into a struggle for survival as the land awakens, banishing any invaders who try to set foot on its icy shores. Valheim version 1.0 is available now on PC, Linux, Mac, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Valheim - Official Version 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Spin the slot machine and see how powerful you'll become! Luck shapes your arsenal, but only skill keeps you alive in this high-stakes bullet heaven roguelite. Master unique weapons and destroy the Spawners summoning endless hordes, and push your luck to the limit. Check out the Amazing Slot Survivor trailer for this upcoming bullet heaven action roguelike game to see gameplay and more. 

Amazing Slot Survivor will be available on PC in 2026.
title: Amazing Slot Survivor - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Reveal Trailer for Mihira: The Eternal Arc, a third-person narrative-driven action-adventure game developed by Studio Yeoun. Players will embark on a riveting journey based on the concept of time. Navigate shifting realities, engage in melee-based combat, and secure fragments of time to ensure fate doesn't collapse in the process. Mihira: The Eternal Arc is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Mihira: The Eternal Arc - Official Reveal Trailer
